script_line: Coming down is worse than going up.

risks.risk: she starts walking down (becomes a different beat)
risks.prevented_by: she stays; no step taken, no foot off the top step
one tightening of the grip; NEG-WARP-C; HOLD-C
no speaking, no mouth moving; the action is one breath
